chief_complaint: Uncontrolled hypertension with obesity and prediabetes
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 43-year-old white male with a long-standing history of essential hypertension diagnosed in 1995, obesity (BMI ≥30) noted since 2017, and prediabetes identified in 2014 (A1c 6.3%). Blood pressure recorded at the last visit (April 2018) was 149/91 mmHg (stage‑2 hypertension) while on a low dose of losartan 25 mg daily. He also has chronic sinusitis (since 2018) with a prior episode of acute bacterial sinusitis in 2017, anemia diagnosed in 2015, and ongoing psychosocial stressors including work stress and exposure to community violence. Healthcare utilization has been minimal, with only one outpatient encounter since 2015 and no recent laboratory monitoring (lipids, renal function, iron studies). Current medications are limited to losartan and diphenhydramine, suggesting under‑treatment of his metabolic‑cardiovascular risk profile.
